name: fieldAcFlag
meaning: Progress.runtimeFlags (+0xb4) bit 0, a bitfield VIEW of that u8 (runtimeFlags stays u8; the union member Progress.runtimeBits gives this view). Only two accesses, both in Progress_Reset: cleared at 0x50ba4d and read at 0x50bc2f to store field_ac = bit ? 0x10 : 0. Nothing in this build sets it, so field_ac is always 0

name: secondDemoNext
meaning: bit 1. Level_FinishScene sets it when attract demo scene -6 ends (0x50c0a0) and clears it when -7 ends (0x50c0c9); Progress_StartAttractDemo (0x50c185) starts -7 when set and -6 when clear, so the two demos alternate. Progress_Reset leaves it

name: timeKeeperUnsaved
meaning: bit 2. Set only by TimeKeeper_HandleMessage msg 1 right after Progress_AwardTimeKeeper (0x4f9ce5). Read only by SceneSheepPanel_Update state 1 (0x4e8c92): when set and no sheep was returned for levelIndexA it freezes the Wolf (msg 0xe) and goes to state 4, which sends MSG_MCARD_AUTOSAVE and clears it (0x4e90b6). A TimeKeeper bonus won since the last hub autosave. Progress_Reset leaves it

name: cardOpen
meaning: bit 3. Set by MCard_Init after Reg_OpenProgressKey succeeded (0x54a913), cleared by MCard_Shutdown (no callers, 0x54a951) and Progress_Reset (0x50b994). Never read

name: saveSlotValid
meaning: bit 4. Set when a card session ends in a known slot: MCS_FINISH_SAVED (0x54bf07), MCS_FINISH_LOADED (0x54bf93), the autosave branch's screen 0x1784 (0x54c694) and MCS_AUTOSAVE_OK (0x54c755). Cleared with autoSaveOn on every card failure, on MCS_FINISH_NO_AUTOSAVE and by Progress_Reset. The autosave gate: the pause menu's automatic-save row is disabled unless set (0x542def); MCardManager on MSG_MCARD_AUTOSAVE (0x4d4b5d) and BonusManager screen 13 (0x49ca7f) require it

name: autoSaveOn
meaning: bit 5, the 'automatic save' setting. Set only by MCS_FINISH_LOADED (0x54bfc1), toggled by the pause menu (0x542e77), cleared with saveSlotValid on every card failure, on MCS_FINISH_NO_AUTOSAVE and by Progress_Reset. Read for the pause menu's on/off text (0x542e2f) and by the MCardManager (0x4d4b7a) and BonusManager (0x49ca99) autosave gates

name: unused
meaning: bits 6-7: never read or written anywhere in the image
